crossRefs.note: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one…
One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.
Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a…
Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,
For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it is received with thanksgiving.
To the pure, all things are pure; but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind…
But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”
A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”
But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’
But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’
But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of the idol until now, eat as of a thing…
For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
translations.bsb: I am convinced and fully persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself. But if anyone regards something as unclean, then for him it is unclean.
translations.kjv: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
translations.asv: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself: save that to him who accounteth anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
